evals.prompt: Audit this login screen for WCAG: caption text #9CA3AF on white, placeholder #6B7280 on white, 32 px tall icon buttons on mobile.
evals.expected_output: A findings table citing WCAG 2.2 criteria with computed contrast ratios, target size analysis distinguishing 2.5.8 AA from platform minimums, severity, confidence and effort.
expectations: Reports about 2.5:1 or lower for #9CA3AF on white as failing 1.4.3
Reports #6B7280 on white as passing at about 4.8:1 or states the computed ratio correctly
Uses 2.5.8 (24 by 24 CSS px) as the AA target size criterion, not 2.5.5
Notes that 32 px is below iOS 44 pt and Android 48 dp guidance
